title: Nobody Here Ages But The STATUE
premise: In a sunny hilltop town where you give a giant stone statue your year on every birthday so nobody ages, I watch the statue get younger one wrinkle a day while my mom grows her first gray hair and slips out before sunrise.
twist: Mom is taking her own years back from the statue, one every morning, so she can grow old beside my dad, the only man in town who never gave one away. On my birthday I keep mine.
world: A hilltop park above a small town of rose sandstone houses and sunflower window boxes: a long flight of brick steps, sunflower beds, a giant seated sandstone statue with a stone beard, a brass tray of birthday candles, a bakery with a striped awning.
